# Purpose

This workflow identifies nucleosomes with large changes in occupancy, fuzziness,
and position.

# Dependencies

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(plyranges)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Functions

```{r functions}
# Read a DANPOS3 result table and standardize commonly used columns.
set.seed(1425)
read_nuc_file <- function(file) {
  nucs <- readr::read_tsv(
    file = file,
    na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "Inf", "-Inf"),
    trim_ws = TRUE,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  nucs <- nucs %>%
    mutate(
      start = suppressWarnings(as.integer(start)),
      end = suppressWarnings(as.integer(end))
    )
  nucs
}
```

```{r}
# Find the first ranked position where the spline derivative exceeds the threshold.
# The default return value remains a numeric cutoff so existing code can continue to
# use occCutOff, fuzzCutOff, and shiftCutOff directly.
get_high_var_nucs <- function(ranked_dat,
                              slope_at_cutoff = 1,
                              plot_cutoff = TRUE,
                              return_details = FALSE, shift=FALSE) {
  
  if(shift){
    fitx <- smooth.spline(
      x = ranked_dat$fdr_rank,
      y = ranked_dat$norm_fdr,spar = 0.8
    )
  } else {
    fitx <- smooth.spline(
      x = ranked_dat$fdr_rank,
      y = ranked_dat$norm_fdr
    )
  }
  
  f1 <- predict(
    fitx,
    x = ranked_dat$fdr_rank,
    deriv = 1
  )
  
  # Find the cutoff position where the slope is > slope_at_cutoff
  slope_above_cutoff <- which(f1$y > slope_at_cutoff)
  
  # positions are only valid after the first 1000 lowest variances. 
  # This is necessary as sometimes the first ones have a quite high predicted slope. 
  valid_cutoff_positions <- slope_above_cutoff[slope_above_cutoff > 1000]
  cutOff <- min(valid_cutoff_positions) / nrow(ranked_dat)
  
  cutOff_FDR <- ranked_dat %>%
    filter(fdr_rank == cutOff) %>% 
    pull(fdr)
  
  
  plt <- ranked_dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fdr_rank, y = norm_fdr)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(
      data = ranked_dat %>% filter(fdr_rank >= cutOff),
      color = "red",
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cutOff, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      x = "normalized rank",
      y = "normalized score",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Cutoff score = ", ifelse(shift,signif(cutOff_FDR, 5),signif(10^(-cutOff_FDR), 5))
      )
    ) +
    ggpubr::labs_pubr() +
    ggpubr::border()
  
  if (plot_cutoff) {
    print(plt)
  }
  
  details <- list(
    cutOff_FDR = cutOff_FDR,
    cutOff_rank = cutOff,
    plot = plt
  )
  
  if (return_details) {
    return(details)
  }
  
  cutOff_FDR
}
```

```{r}
fuzzyorOcc <- function(df, colname="smt_diff_fdr_adj"){
  df %>%
  mutate(fdr = -log10(pmax(.[[colname]], .Machine$double.xmin)))  %>%
  arrange(fdr) %>% filter(!is.na(fdr)) %>%
  mutate(fdr_rank = 1:dplyr::n(),
         fdr_rank = fdr_rank/max(fdr_rank,na.rm = T),
         norm_fdr = fdr/max(fdr,na.rm = T))
}

out_dir <- "final_results_dismnaseq"
dir.create(out_dir)
```
Calculate occupancy
```{r}
occupancy <- lapply(list(nucs_i18,nucs_i44), function(x){
  res <- fuzzyorOcc(x,colname = "smt_diff_fdr_adj") %>%  get_high_var_nucs( slope_at_cutoff = 1, plot_cutoff = TRUE, return_details = T)
  outTable <- fuzzyorOcc(x,colname = "smt_diff_fdr_adj") %>% 
  mutate(highOccFDR = dplyr::if_else((fdr >= res$cutOff_FDR), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "strand", "center",
                  "control_smt_loca", "treat_smt_loca", "control_smt_val",
                  "treat_smt_val", "smt_log2FC", "smt_diff_log10pval", 
                  "smt_diff_FDR", "control_fuzziness_score", "ID", # control_fuzziness_score is included to filter for well positioned nucleosomes
                  "smt_diff_fdr_adj", "fdr","fdr_rank", "norm_fdr", "highOccFDR"))
  
  bed <-   outTable %>% 
    mutate(name = ID, score = smt_diff_fdr_adj) %>% 
  filter(highOccFDR) %>% 
  as_granges()
  
  return(list(cutoff=res, result=outTable, bed=bed))
}) %>% setNames(c("i18","i44"))
```

calculate shift

```{r}
shift <- lapply(list(nucs_i18,nucs_i44), function(x){
  res <- x %>% filter(!is.na(treat2control_dis_adj)) %>%
    mutate(fdr = (treat2control_dis_adj)) %>% # using nucleosome distance as substitute for significance value
    arrange(fdr) %>% 
    mutate(fdr_rank = 1:dplyr::n(),
           fdr_rank = fdr_rank/max(fdr_rank,na.rm = T),
           norm_fdr = fdr/max(fdr,na.rm = T)) %>%  
    get_high_var_nucs( slope_at_cutoff = 1, plot_cutoff = TRUE, return_details = T, shift = TRUE)
  
  outTable <- x %>% filter(!is.na(treat2control_dis_adj)) %>%
    mutate(fdr = (treat2control_dis_adj)) %>% # using nucleosome distance as substitute for significance value
    arrange(fdr) %>% 
    mutate(fdr_rank = 1:dplyr::n(),
           fdr_rank = fdr_rank/max(fdr_rank,na.rm = T),
           norm_fdr = fdr/max(fdr,na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(highShiftFDR = dplyr::if_else((fdr >= res$cutOff_FDR), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "strand", "center",
                  "control_smt_loca", "treat_smt_loca", "treat2control_dis",
                  "treat_smt_loca_smooth", "control_smt_loca_smooth", 
                  "treat2control_dis_adj", "control_fuzziness_score", "ID", # control_fuzziness_score is included to filter for well positioned nucleosomes
                  "fdr","fdr_rank", "norm_fdr", "highShiftFDR"))
  
  bed <-   outTable %>% 
    mutate(name = ID, score = treat2control_dis_adj) %>% 
  filter(highShiftFDR) %>% 
  as_granges()
  
  return(list(cutoff=res, result=outTable, bed=bed))
}) %>% setNames(c("i18","i44"))
```

## Make violin plots in Extended Fig. 5

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)


add_levene_p <- function(plot, center = median) {
  
  # Extract and clean the data stored in the ggplot object
  dat <- plot$data %>%
    filter(is.finite(LFC)) %>%
    mutate(
      Timepoint = factor(
        Timepoint,
        levels = c("18hpi", "44hpi")
      )
    )
  
  # Levene's test
  lev <- dat %>%
    levene_test(LFC ~ Timepoint, center = center)
  
  # Calculate a suitable vertical position for the annotation
  y_range <- range(dat$LFC, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_span  <- diff(y_range)
  
  if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span == 0) {
    y_span <- max(abs(y_range), 1)
  }
  
  # Prepare the annotation data
  lev_annotation <- lev %>%
    transmute(
      group1 = "18hpi",
      group2 = "44hpi",
      y.position = y_range[2] + 0.10 * y_span,
      label = if_else(
        p < 0.001,
        "Levene p < 0.001",
        paste0("Levene p = ", formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "fg"))
      )
    )
  
  # Add bracket and p-value
  plot +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      lev_annotation,
      label = "label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))
    )
}
```

## Find some interesting genes to plot

```{r}
library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)

# Input files
gff_file <- "/data/di_mnaseq/Watzlowik_et_al_2023/nextmna/resources/PlasmoDB-68_Pfalciparum3D7.gff"
bed_file <- "/data/di_mnaseq/Watzlowik_et_al_2023/nextmna/final_results_dismnaseq/i18Fuzz_20perc.bed"

# Import files as GRanges objects
gff <- import.gff3(gff_file)
genes <- gff[gff$type == "protein_coding_gene"]

# Find BED–gene overlaps where at least 99 bases overlap. Strand is ignored.
annotate_bed <- lapply(list.files(path = out_dir,pattern = "20perc.bed", full.names = TRUE), function(x){
bed <- import(x)
hits <- findOverlaps(
    query = bed,
    subject = genes,
    minoverlap = 99,
    ignore.strand = TRUE)

# Calculate the exact overlap width for each match
overlap_width <- width(
    pintersect(
        bed[queryHits(hits)],
        genes[subjectHits(hits)],
        ignore.strand = TRUE
    )
)

# Create output table
result <- data.frame(
    region_id = bed$name[queryHits(hits)],
    region_chr = as.character(seqnames(bed))[queryHits(hits)],
    region_start = start(bed)[queryHits(hits)],
    region_end = end(bed)[queryHits(hits)],
    gene_chr = as.character(seqnames(genes))[subjectHits(hits)],
    gene_start = start(genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
    gene_end = end(genes)[subjectHits(hits)],
    overlap_bases = overlap_width,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add common GFF gene annotation columns when available
gene_rows <- subjectHits(hits)

for (column in c("ID", "Name", "gene_id", "gene_name", "locus_tag")) {
    if (column %in% names(mcols(genes))) {
        result[[column]] <- as.character(mcols(genes)[[column]][gene_rows])
    }
}
 return(result) 
}) %>% setNames(list.files(path = out_dir,pattern = "20perc.bed") %>% gsub("_20perc.bed","",.))
names(annotate_bed)
## add the LFC values and p values to help choose interesting genes
i18res <- rio::import_list(paste0(out_dir,"/i18_results.xlsx"))
i44res <- rio::import_list(paste0(out_dir,"/i44_results.xlsx"))

annotate_bed$i18Occ <- S4Vectors::merge(annotate_bed$i18Occ,i18res$occupancy, all.x=T,all.y=F, by.x="region_id", by.y="ID")
annotate_bed$i18Fuzz <- S4Vectors::merge(annotate_bed$i18Fuzz,i18res$fuzziness, all.x=T,all.y=F, by.x="region_id", by.y="ID")
annotate_bed$i18Shift <- S4Vectors::merge(annotate_bed$i18Shift,i18res$shift, all.x=T,all.y=F, by.x="region_id", by.y="ID")
annotate_bed$i44Occ <- S4Vectors::merge(annotate_bed$i44Occ,i44res$occupancy, all.x=T,all.y=F, by.x="region_id", by.y="ID")
annotate_bed$i44Fuzz <- S4Vectors::merge(annotate_bed$i44Fuzz,i44res$fuzziness, all.x=T,all.y=F, by.x="region_id", by.y="ID")
annotate_bed$i44Shift <- S4Vectors::merge(annotate_bed$i44Shift,i44res$shift, all.x=T,all.y=F, by.x="region_id", by.y="ID")

geneids <- setdiff(intersect(annotate_bed$i18Fuzz$ID,c(annotate_bed$i18Occ$ID,annotate_bed$i18Shift$ID)),intersect(annotate_bed$i44Fuzz$ID,c(annotate_bed$i44Occ$ID,annotate_bed$i44Shift$ID))) %>% unique() 


annots <- plasmoRUtils::getTable("Plasmodium falciparum 3D7", db="plasmodb")
annots <- subset(annots, annots$`Gene ID` %in% geneids)
annotate_bed$genes_affected_nuclOcc_18hpionly <- annots
rio::export(annotate_bed,file = paste0(out_dir,"/annotated_BEDs_20perc_genes.xlsx"))



```
